set.name: Color Picker
set.description: Field for picking one free color: swatch + hex value + chevron, same anatomy as Select. Open state pairs with Color Picker Panel placed 4px below the control. The Swatch fill is the value (override per instance); the empty state shows a dashed swatch and a placeholder. Hex is always left-to-right text.
